authorship_note: Frozen research gold authored independently of ClaimProfileV0 expected_evidence_forms implementation. Compatibility labels express task-appropriate evidence-form coverage only; they do not establish source authority, factual support, or sufficiency.

cases.claim: Women had a higher rate than Men.
cases.rationale: A measurement can directly bear on the comparison, but the current descriptive vocabulary may also expect a document representation.

cases.claim: Group A had a lower rate than Group B.
cases.rationale: The supplied world contains both quantitative measurement and documentary representation of the comparative result.

cases.claim: Version 2 had greater latency than Version 1.
cases.rationale: A registry entry alone is not an ordinary evidence form for the magnitude comparison absent measurement or a document reporting it.

cases.claim: The treatment arm had fewer events than the control arm.
cases.rationale: A document reporting the comparative result can be relevant even when raw measurements are absent; the form coverage is incomplete, not wholly mismatched.
An inspection record can directly document equipment state; document evidence must not be treated as categorically irrelevant to status claims.
An authoritative registry is an ordinary evidence form for license status, though the descriptive mapping may name additional possible forms.
Operational status may be recorded in structured state plus an inspection or release document; the combination should not be treated as no-match.
A bare measurement form does not by itself identify the asserted operational status in this bounded form-level test.
